notablePrerequisites:
You must have a land drop available.
Four nonbasic lands under opponents' control.
description:
Activate Field, targeting a land and triggering Rings of Brighthearth.
Pay to copy the Field effect, targeting a different land.
Resolve both triggers and the resulting Ob Nixilis triggers, forcing all opponent to lose 20 life.
Use Crucible of Worlds to play Field.
Repeat steps 1-3.
